# Gary Lucy

> Official site of Gary Lucy, a British screen and stage actor with nearly
> three decades of professional credits.

Gary Lucy is a British actor known for major returning roles in Hollyoaks
(Luke Morgan), Footballers' Wives (Kyle Pascoe), The Bill (Will Fletcher)
and EastEnders (Danny Pennant), and currently appears as Jason Agnew in
Channel 5's The Good Ship Murder. He won Best Newcomer at the 2000 British
Soap Awards and led the UK touring stage production of The Full Monty.

## Key facts
- Full name: Gary Edward Lucy
- Born: 27 November 1981, Chigwell, Essex, England
- Years active: 1996–present
- Official site: https://www.garylucy.co.uk/
